meta.title: Resource Tracker
meta.trackerFunction: Tracks who is allocated to which project line, and how many open tasks each carries right now.
meta.trackerPurpose: Surfaces allocation imbalance — one line quietly carrying most of the open task load — before it becomes a bottleneck, using counts derived live from the trackers rather than typed-in guesses.
meta.trackerOutcome: A realistic, canon-derived picture of workload across the studio, kept honest by the 'derived, never stored' rule — recount from source every refresh, never hand-edit a total.
